results.quote: The same evening, the queue that passes orders to the WMS backed up for four hours.
results.finding: p08's controlling idea is the stock chain that let marketplaces oversell; the WMS order-queue backlog is a second, unrelated failure (late confirmations) that p08 does not join. It is restated where it is used (p28, 'When the queue to Kestrel & Pine's WMS backed up for four hours on the Oversell evening'), so the sentence here can go or be tied to the oversell.
How the Pieces Fit Together ¶11: bol's asynchronous API and its 12-month retirement policy are joined as one idea by spec p33.
In Practice ¶9: Mirakl and DSA Article 30 are joined by spec p62 as the operator side and its legal core.
When It Goes Wrong ¶1: the age monitor and early cancellation are joined by spec p65 as 'two controls are cheapest'.
Every unit advances one of S1-S6 through its section's (or its own) advances_thesis; the operator-side paragraphs (In Practice ¶8-9) trace to S6 via their paragraph-level declaration.

Each table, figure, quotation and figure-bearing fact is followed (or framed) by what it shows: e.g. the scorecard table by 'Read the table as an integration specification', the flows table by the events rule, the policy table by 'The last row is...', the stage table by 'The judgement', the variant table by 'The second column is the one most merchants get wrong', ZEOS by 'For a merchant that means a third kind of stock location'.
